tip_exiftool: Enable writing metadata into original files via ExifTool queue. If disabled, metadata is only written to the Immich database.

tip_date_to: End date (e.g. 2024-12-31 or 31.12.2024). Leave blank for no upper limit.

tip_photo_slice:
Optional photo slice per date (disabled by default).

• If a single date is set (e.g. Sep 13) and slice is [1 to 5] — only the first 5 photos of that day in chronological order are processed.
• If a date range is set (e.g. Sep 01 - Sep 30) — from EACH calendar day, photos from X to Y are processed.
• Disabled: all photos of each date are processed.
tip_slice_from: Start photo number for each day (1-based, e.g. 1).
tip_slice_to: End photo number for each day (e.g. 5).
slice_error_range: Error: invalid photo range (from X to Y, where X >= 1 and X <= Y)!
tip_iptc:
Write legacy IPTC IIM metadata (1991 standard).

Enabled by default for maximum compatibility with legacy photo viewers.

⚡ Optimization: For large tag counts (25-50), it is recommended to TURN OFF. This eliminates tag duplication, halves metadata size, and speeds up file writing 3-5x by avoiding full file rewrites on the server disk. Modern XMP (Lightroom) and EXIF (Windows) will still be fully saved.
